review_policy.clean;mixed: Mixed-script review is an additional classification layer; do not remove from clean solely because of this overlap.
review_policy.clean;recovered_review_only: Recovered copy already appears in clean; keep recovered copy review-only.
review_policy.clean;mixed;recovered_review_only: Same content appears in clean and mixed review; recovered copy remains review-only.
review_policy.mixed;quarantine: Quarantine reason takes precedence; keep quarantined pending manual review.
review_policy.all_other_categories: Manual review required; no automatic action.

limitations: NFC-hash matches identify exact normalized text duplicates, not semantic duplicates.
